//: Railway reads this file from the repository root, so it configures the DEFAULT service. Without it Railway falls back to railpack auto-detection, which cannot find a start command in a Bun workspace and fails the build. For a multi-service deploy, point each additional service at its own config from the service settings page — /apps/web/railway.json and /apps/worker/railway.json — and leave Root Directory unset, because these Dockerfiles expect the repository root as their build context.
